           <h1>Meshery v0.7.7</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.7">Released</a> on January 05, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.7.6 to 1.7.11 in /scripts/component_updater @dependabot (#9682)</li>
  <li>[relationships] Fix incorrect query in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">hierarchical_config</code> relationship definition. @MUzairS15 (#9837)</li>
  <li>[Models] Relationships for Kubernetes ConfigMap using Environment Variables @leecalcote (#9816)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix experimental model command in mesheryctl @LakshyaSatpal (#9813)</li>
  <li>add reference link in mesheryctl @Althaf66 (#9707)</li>
  <li>fix the grammatical issue #9810 @Althaf66 (#9811)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add Postgres Database Icon @Akshun-01 (#9674)</li>
  <li>Added icons for Kubernetes Node Metrics component @nwanduka (#9760)</li>
  <li>Fix connection page issues @sudhanshutech (#9838)</li>
  <li>Fix Environment options update and undefined bug in connections @sudhanshutech (#9831)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add info icon to prompt component @Yashsharma1911 (#9826)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.12.7 to 3.12.17 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9814)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/material from 5.14.19 to 5.15.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9792)</li>
  <li>Prevent common modal from rerender @Yashsharma1911 (#9822)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix Environment options update and undefined bug in connections @sudhanshutech (#9831)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Bump MeshMap Snapshot @theBeginner86 (#9836)</li>
  <li>[Server] Seed keys for local provider @Yashsharma1911 (#9771)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.12.7 to 3.12.17 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9814)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/material from 5.14.19 to 5.15.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9792)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/onsi/gomega from 1.27.10 to 1.30.0 @dependabot (#9799)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/cobra from 1.7.0 to 1.8.0 @dependabot (#9798)</li>
  <li>[Chore] GH Issue Template: Update and rename meshmodel.md to models.md @leecalcote (#9820)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fixed mobile search results  @Savio629 (#9613)</li>
  <li>Adding consistent font-weight for list-structure  @yash37158 (#9759)</li>
  <li>fix v0.6 navbar dropdown and details marker in v0.6 meshery docs  @Aniket-76 (#9835)</li>
  <li>add reference link in mesheryctl @Althaf66 (#9707)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Update docs for configuring logs at runtime. @MUzairS15 (#9827)</li>
  <li>docs: logical concepts update @leecalcote (#9808)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Relationships: Missing color for info/tip/note Alerts + Models: Missing color @brandonkylely (#9823)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Akshun-01, @Althaf66, @Aniket-76, @LakshyaSatpal, @MUzairS15, @Savio629, @Yashsharma1911, @alphaX86, @brandonkylely, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote, @nwanduka, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86, @vishalvivekm, @yash37158 and Ingle.extern</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>

</ul>

</ul>

<ul>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.73</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.73">Released</a> on June 12, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Server] Pkg generation during download of design. @MUzairS15 (#11162)</li>
  <li>Bump braces from 3.0.2 to 3.0.3 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#11155)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix ratelimit artifacthub w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11144)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix list –count is not returning the total when page flag is present @lekaf974 (#11143)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Move ProgressBar to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">useSnackbar</code> and convert to react <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">functional</code> component @sudhanshutech (#11159)</li>
  <li>Move Schema Validation Actor to WebWorker @codeSafari10 (#11141)</li>
  <li>Revert “Bump and migrate notistack according new version” @aabidsofi19 (#11158)</li>
  <li>Bump braces from 3.0.2 to 3.0.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#11154)</li>
  <li>Bump and migrate notistack according new version @sudhanshutech (#11147)</li>
  <li>Fix filters not getting fetched locally @shubham251972 (#11150)</li>
  <li>fix(ui): dashboard-only responsiveness @dottharun (#11152)</li>
  <li>Make CASL CAN case insensitive @dragon-slayer875 (#11148)</li>
  <li>[UI] use connection metadata to get context @codeSafari10 (#11145)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump braces from 3.0.2 to 3.0.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#11154)</li>
  <li>added issue/docs-needed @milinddethe15 (#11151)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19, @codeSafari10, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @dottharun, @dragon-slayer875, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @milinddethe15, @shubham251972 and @sudhanshutech</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.74</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.74">Released</a> on June 15, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Dosc] Revert removal of line return to ensure README hyperlinks show as intended. @jameshorton2337 (#11182)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: logs to have same current model and extracted model  @Jougan-0 (#11118)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix notistack crash @codeSafari10 (#11186)</li>
  <li>fix height of registry section @sudhanshutech (#10642)</li>
  <li>remove unwanted styling add tooltip for unpublish confirmation @sudhanshutech (#11172)</li>
  <li>[bug] fix crash of connections page @sudhanshutech (#11171)</li>
  <li>Revert “Revert “Bump and migrate notistack according new version”” @sudhanshutech (#11160)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>add missing action func to infomodal  @sudhanshutech (#11173)</li>
  <li>[bug] fix crash of connections page @sudhanshutech (#11171)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump github.com/vektah/gqlparser/v2 from 2.5.11 to 2.5.14 @dependabot (#11167)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Updated the installation link of Meshery by Minikube using Helm @Aviral0702 (#11181)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aviral0702, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19, @codeSafari10, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @jameshorton2337, @leecalcote and @sudhanshutech</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }

              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });

        event.preventDefault();

          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.75</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.75">Released</a> on June 19, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[chore] migrate /bin/bash shebangs to /usr/bin/env bash @aabidsofi19 (#11209)</li>
  <li>[Relationships]: Nginx ingress relationships @innocentrda (#11121)</li>
  <li>remove Logrus with meshkit logger w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11176)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>workflow update to mail error log w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11156)</li>
  <li>Aijeyomah/feature/list exp relationship @Jougan-0 (#11101)</li>
  <li>refactor(components): Promote component command @lekaf974 (#11135)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Registry log dynamic @Jougan-0 (#11065)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Add permission check for reset database @dragon-slayer875 (#11193)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>workflow update to mail error log w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11156)</li>
  <li>Update build-and-release-edge.yml @MUzairS15 (#11199)</li>
  <li>Bump golang.org/x/oauth2 from 0.16.0 to 0.20.0 @dependabot (#10879)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] migrate /bin/bash shebangs to /usr/bin/env bash @aabidsofi19 (#11210)</li>
  <li>Update ui.md - enhanced /docs/pages/extensibility/ui.md @ayushrakesh (#11200)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Partial: Instructions for Creating a New Component with UI Schema @leecalcote (#11201)</li>
  <li>Updated mesheryctl command for applying WASM Filter @Aviral0702 (#11197)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Refinement of the description of relationships and models @leecalcote (#11195)</li>
  <li>refactor(components): Promote component command @lekaf974 (#11135)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aviral0702, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @aabidsofi19, @ayushrakesh, @dependabot, @dragon-slayer875, @innocentrda, @leecalcote, @lekaf974 and @vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.76">Released</a> on June 21, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI]: Add a new Catalog page and it’s menu item @dottharun (#11050)</li>
  <li>fix(ui): InfoModal bug in designs-page DataTable @dottharun (#11177)</li>
  <li>Fix hover over avatar @EleisonC (#11165)</li>
  <li>migrated cypress tests to playwright @DevRish (#11095)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azidentity from 1.4.0 to 1.6.0 @dependabot (#11153)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update Staging Playground Workflow  @cpepper96 (#11213)</li>
  <li>fix directory address w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11215)</li>
  <li>workflow update for proper logs w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11214)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bug: Fixed the logic to not show the components when it is empty @ayushrakesh (#11221)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.77</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.77">Released</a> on June 28, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Change jitsi helm chart link @Alero-Awani (#11243)</li>
  <li>chore: add missing logLevel w/signoff @Jougan-0 (#11258)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Server] Use filename as design name while importing design @dusdjhyeon (#11097)</li>
  <li>audit and fix sorting issues @sudhanshutech (#11257)</li>
  <li>Adding Design Icon for ArgoCD Component - Application @JAYANTJOSHI001 (#11242)</li>
  <li>Captain/publishmodal @captain-Akshay (#11140)</li>
  <li>[Server] Versioning of Designs @MUzairS15 (#11229)</li>
  <li>fix: dashboard table misalignment @dottharun (#11239)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update tooltip variant in prompt component @dragon-slayer875 (#11237)</li>
  <li>[chore] rename adapter selector field label @leecalcote (#11224)</li>
  <li>fix: ci eslint error unused-var in tests @dottharun (#11228)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Chore] Upgrade Snapshot workflow to v0.2.8 @leecalcote (#11261)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Build issue fix in docs @iArchitSharma (#11254)</li>
  <li>[Server] Versioning of Designs @MUzairS15 (#11229)</li>
  <li>feat: Update styles in SCSS files meshery docs @animeshchaudhri (#11232)</li>
  <li>Heading included for Related Integration sections @iArchitSharma (#11211)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Alero-Awani, @JAYANTJOSHI001, @Jougan-0, @MUzairS15, @animeshchaudhri, @captain-Akshay, @dottharun, @dragon-slayer875, @dusdjhyeon, @iArchitSharma, @leecalcote, @sudhanshutech and captain-Akshay</p>

  src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
